sessions.phase_label: Requirements scoping and initial CAD package agreement

requirements.title: Main Housing SolidWorks CAD
requirements.definition: Create a complete editable SolidWorks model of the primary enclosure shell and overall mechanical architecture.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the primary housing model and overall enclosure architecture; component-specific mounts, latch behavior, and aesthetic conformity are tracked separately.

requirements.title: Housing Aesthetic Conformity
requirements.definition: Shape the enclosure exterior in accordance with the client's supplied aesthetic reference.
requirements.boundary_note: Aesthetic conformity can be reviewed or revised independently of housing fitment and internal mechanism behavior.

requirements.title: Internal Latch Mechanism
requirements.definition: Design the functional internal latch mechanism using the client's supplied latch layout as a reference.
requirements.boundary_note: The latch is an independently functional mechanism; servo mounting and general housing geometry can fail or change without changing the latch requirement.

requirements.title: PCB Fitment and Mounting
requirements.definition: Provide enclosure features that correctly locate, retain, and accommodate the approximately 65 mm by 40 mm by 12 mm custom PCB.
requirements.boundary_note: PCB fitment has its own dimensions and acceptance criterion and is separate from battery-holder and servo integration.

requirements.title: Battery Holder Fitment and Mounting
requirements.definition: Provide enclosure features that correctly accommodate and retain the 18650 Li-ion battery holder.
requirements.boundary_note: Battery-holder fitment can be designed, revised, and verified independently of PCB and servo mounting.

requirements.title: Servo Fitment and Mounting
requirements.definition: Provide mechanical fitment and mounting features for the internal servo motor.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers secure mechanical integration of the servo, not the independently functional latch geometry that the servo may actuate.

requirements.title: Injection-Molding-Compatible Design
requirements.definition: Design the product for reliable plastic injection molding in ABS or a PC/ABS blend, including appropriate wall thickness, draft, and assembly geometry.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers manufacturable product geometry; the requested DFM review output and prototype-printing compatibility are independently tracked.

requirements.title: FDM and SLA Prototype Printability
requirements.definition: Ensure the design can be produced as functional FDM or SLA prototypes for mechanism evaluation before injection molding.
requirements.boundary_note: Printability is a product-design constraint for two prototype processes, not a generic testing-process Requirement.

requirements.title: Injection-Molding DFM Review
requirements.definition: Provide an initial DFM review covering injection-molding concerns such as draft angles, wall thickness, and assembly considerations.
requirements.boundary_note: The review is an independently requested engineering output; it is separate from implementing DFM-compliant geometry.

requirements.title: Initial Tolerance Review
requirements.definition: Perform a basic tolerance analysis of the initial mechanical design and component interfaces.
requirements.boundary_note: Tolerance analysis is an independently requested engineering assessment rather than a generic test or an attribute of one component mount.

requirements.title: STEP File Delivery
requirements.definition: Deliver production-ready STEP files suitable for prototype production and manufacturing review.
requirements.boundary_note: The neutral STEP deliverable can be generated and accepted independently of the editable SolidWorks model and drawing package.

requirements.title: Engineering Drawing Package
requirements.definition: Deliver an initial production-oriented engineering drawing set with key dimensions and assembly details.
requirements.boundary_note: Key dimensions, assembly details, drawing formats, and applicable drafting conventions are attributes of one drawing package; STEP files and the BOM remain separate outputs.

requirements.title: Bill of Materials
requirements.definition: Provide a bill of materials identifying the components required for the designed assembly.
requirements.boundary_note: The BOM is a structured assembly deliverable that can be completed or revised independently of geometric engineering drawings.

requirements.title: 1.2 Meter Drop Resistance
requirements.definition: Design the handheld device enclosure to protect the product against a 1.2 meter drop.
requirements.boundary_note: Drop resistance is an independently measurable durability behavior, not merely an attribute of ergonomic or manufacturing requirements.

requirements.title: Handheld Ergonomics
requirements.definition: Provide clean ergonomics appropriate for a handheld consumer device.
requirements.boundary_note: Ergonomic suitability can be evaluated and revised independently of drop protection, aesthetics, and internal component fitment.

requirements.title: Indoor and Light-Outdoor Compatibility
requirements.definition: Design the handheld device for operation in indoor and light-outdoor consumer environments.
requirements.boundary_note: The operating-environment constraint may independently affect materials and enclosure construction, but no stronger sealing or weather-resistance criterion is stated.

unresolved_candidates.description: The supplied latch sketch and aesthetic references are not present as message text, so their detailed geometry and visual criteria cannot be recovered; only the high-level latch and aesthetic obligations are identifiable.
